name: Italian Grand Prix
summary: Kimi Antonelli delivered one of the great modern F1 drives, recovering from 19th on the grid (a 30-place power-unit grid penalty) to win the Italian Grand Prix at Monza, passing team mate George Russell with three laps to go. Antonelli becomes the first Italian to win at Monza since Ludovico Scarfiotti in 1966, and extends his championship lead over Russell to 66 points. Pierre Gasly took a stunning maiden pole for Alpine, but a Lap 2 red flag — triggered by Charles Leclerc's heavy crash at Parabolica — cost him track position and he fell to 7th by the flag. Max Verstappen recovered from P5 on the grid to complete the podium, while Lando Norris passed team mate Oscar Piastri on the final lap for P4.
